Visible stable frame/hub camera fitting is possible, but filling these hidden values with defaults would not be observed mechanical state.

Spring/pen/cone/bar close-ups have moving parts and crop out known fixed frame-level anchors. Independent source measurements exist, but no >=6 noncoplanar fit +>=2 held-out named CAD features at a fully source-established dynamic pose for every required frame. Alternate visible checks examined: frame clamp screws, gear hubs, rocker caps and pen hardware; source physical pixels are not absent merely because graphics cover the shot.

alternateSourceEvidence.reason: Released rocker distal corners are known, but this end-on source face/glare patch is not a confirmed material corner. Upper/lower local corners [.14524007,.02929464,-.00125] and [.14625457,.0237995,-.00125]m, rod-axis candidate [.13306740213488345,.016456064115939025,-.00125]m came from independent CAD/rocker peer analysis. Actual100s crop shows a bright rectangular face, with pin axial-depth/visible-dimple identity still ambiguous. A glare centroid must not be treated as one of those CAD corners.

blockers.reason: Visible measuring-stick adjustment and moving pen show real dynamics; precise slider mm stations, re-zero wire fixture, spring counter/DC setting, crank phase and complete camera/pen pose cannot be recovered by claiming white/yellow diagram markers are CAD landmarks.

Closing whole-machine source shots differ in framing from early camera. Actual205s has six independent fixed-part fit pixels and two physical clamp-head checks, heldout22.492px. Other closing required frames184..188 and198..212 still need independent checks and a source-backed complete physical setup; approved hold does not exempt presenter beside a visible machine.

Every decoded native frame is sampled, including all edits/dynamic changes. Human shot/motion representative boundaries have up to0.2s onset uncertainty (subsecond review cadence), not a fabricated exact exposure-time onset; full gate remains blocked until unique native boundary frames are resolved.

coverage.nonMachinePolicy: Hold last matched physical-machine pose; before the first matched source pose retain initial documented CAD rest. Never substitute graph pixels or copyrighted artwork.
